name: @projexlight/sdk-trace
summary: Distributed-tracing primitive for ProjexCloud: span model + OTLP exporter + per-trace query API + regression assertions for CI. Every SDK boundary auto-emits a span via the @trace decorator so a single trace_id walks the request from the API gateway through every SDK that processed it. Foundation for any debugging or SLO investigation.

endpoints.description: Fetch one trace + every span with parent/child links.
Configure an OTLP exporter destination (Datadog / Honeycomb / Tempo / Jaeger).
CI-time assertion: 'this trace should not have grown past N spans / N ms'.

events.name: trace.regression.detected.v1
events.description: Regression assertion failed in CI; carries baseline + observed.

models.description: Per-trace row: trace_id, root_span_id, started_at, total_duration_ms.
Per-span row: span_id, parent_span_id, sdk_name, operation, duration_ms, attributes.

hooks.name: recordSpan
hooks.description: Low-level: write a span. Usually called from the @trace decorator, rarely directly.

hooks.name: getTrace
hooks.description: Fetch a full trace by trace_id; ordered by span graph.

hooks.name: configureExport
hooks.description: Register / update an OTLP export destination.

hooks.name: assertRegression
hooks.description: CI helper — assert a trace stays within baseline bounds.

hooks.name: startSamplingTuner
hooks.description: Background worker: tunes sample_rate per export to stay within destination quota.

scenarios.title: @trace decorator auto-emits spans across SDK boundaries
scenarios.when_to_use: Universal pattern — every SDK service method is decorated; the decorator opens + closes a span, attaching parent context.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Each call to createContact opens a span linked to the parent (incoming request) span. trace_id walks the request all the way through. .span.recorded.v1 emitted (or dropped per sample_rate).

scenarios.title: Debug a slow request via /api/trace/:trace_id
scenarios.when_to_use: Support escalation — customer reports a slow request; pull the trace_id from logs + view the full waterfall.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Full span graph returned. Caller spots the slow span (e.g. sdk-search took 2.3s due to missing index).

scenarios.title: Configure Datadog OTLP export
scenarios.when_to_use: Tenant already uses Datadog — point exports there + set a sample rate to stay within their ingest quota.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Export destination registered. Sampling tuner monitors Datadog ingest cost + adjusts sample_rate if needed.

scenarios.title: CI fails when a synthetic trace grew past baseline
scenarios.when_to_use: PR ran a synthetic load test; we assert the trace stayed within last week's baseline + 20%.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Pass / fail. On fail, emits .regression.detected.v1 + CI step fails with the diff in stdout.

scenarios.title: Sampling tuner backs off when destination throttles
scenarios.when_to_use: Background — exporter starts seeing 429s from Datadog. Tuner halves sample_rate + alerts ops if persistent.
scenarios.example_code:
import { startSamplingTuner } from '@projexlight/sdk-trace';
startSamplingTuner({ tenant_id, interval_min: 5 });
scenarios.expected_outcome: Sample rate adjusts automatically. Persistent throttles page ops via sdk-notification.

compliance_posture.notes: Spans never carry plaintext PII — only field-names + types. Trace export destinations vetted via sdk-vault for outbound URL allow-list. Retention default 14 days; tenants can extend up to 90 with regulated-class storage.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per GB exported to external OTLP sink
